special_traits.name: Inscrutable
special_traits.description: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely

special_traits.name: or detect its thoughts without its permission
special_traits.description: Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_traits.description:
If
the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and
uses Roar.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6
+ 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Roar (3/Day)
actions.description: The sphinx emits a magical roar. When-

actions.name: ever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest)
actions.description: First Roar. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition

actions.name: for 1 minute
actions.description: Second Roar. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. Third Roar. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Arcane Prowl
legendary_actions.description:
The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet
to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet
legendary_actions.description:
Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can't take this action again
until the start of its next turn.
